changes.title: Kalshi permanently bans George Santos after he secretly bet on himself
changes.summary: Kalshi has issued a lifetime ban to former Rep. George Santos after he secretly placed a bet against his own unannounced plans to attend the State of the Union.

changes.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
changes.summary: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000. (Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson).

changes.title: Kalshi Is Imposing Its First-Ever Lifetime Ban on Former Rep. George Santos. Here’s Why

George Santos from accessing the platform after establi.
